## What does this change?

<!-- A short description of what you added, fixed, or corrected. -->


## Type of change

- [ ] Correction (fixed a wrong/broken link, description, or category)
- [ ] New organisation(s) added
- [ ] Tooling / maintenance (validator, CI, docs)
- [ ] Other (please describe)

## Accuracy checklist

- [ ] Every new or changed link points to the organisation's **own official domain** (not a directory, aggregator, or news article)
- [ ] I have opened the link myself and confirmed it resolves to the intended place
- [ ] New organisations are real, verifiable, and relevant to the ecosystem
- [ ] Descriptions are accurate and not overstated (a truthful thin entry beats a padded one)
- [ ] New domains have been added to the `VERIFIED_DOMAINS` allowlist

## Validation

- [ ] I ran `node validate.mjs The_Defence_Ecosystem_v2.html` and all checks pass
- [ ] I reviewed any warnings from the **Abbreviation tripwire** (short domains that don't match the org name)

## Licence

- [ ] I understand that contributions are accepted under the project's licences —
      **code under MIT, content/data under CC BY 4.0** — and I am submitting my own
      work (or work I have the right to contribute).
